title: This is a great app.
body:
The app serves its purpose very well. Design is simple and attractive. Integration with Health is crucial for effectiveness and works very well for me. 
Amount of tasks appears to be limited to 24 tasks (6 per page) which might be deliberate but I would remove this limit. i would make an option to schedule the tasks on calendar and also measure consistency in addition to the streak method already measured. I would also make an opt in option to display streaks or not (some tasks might not need this shown and this could do a bad psychological effect if youre not keeping it as a streak)

I have a couple of other points but this app is the best habit tracker for me out there.

title: A great single source of truth for all your goals
body:
Perfect sync with Apple health. Nice app for the Apple Watch.

Two issues:
1. I wish there was a nicer way to view all the steaks (such as a classic list). It’s really hard to follow all of your goals in the existing way the app offers.
2. The Apple Watch app has an issue with updating. The creators of this app has another app called “HealthFace”, which I really love and recommend, and it shows a much better capabilities of updating the Apple Watch.

Other than that, everything is great!

title: Great Trend Tracker!
body:
I'm really loving both the weekly goals feature and the integration with the Health data. It really feels like a tool I can passively track my performance with while a device (my watch) physically measures my activity. Really great!

I would really love to see improvements to data synchrnozation. Sometimes it feels that data is not properly merged between devices, and it can cause a bit of manual work to consolidate. And I would love to have more integration with data sources. Maybe Duolingo? I don't know.

title: The best - with one feature missing
body:
This is a best app for habit tracking.  I wish you would add the feature of sending alerts only if the habit did not happen. This way I don’t get useless unactionable reminders about items I complete already. 

There is only one other app that does that and it really sets it apart.

I’m going to give streaks another go and see if this is something I can live without or if the developer will implement this super fast ;)
